title: ophrys mammosa subsp. vierhapperi
intro: Ophrys mammosa subsp. vierhapperi, commonly known as the False Bee Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its distinctive appearance, which mimics the female bee, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys mammosa subsp. vierhapperi include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and heal wounds, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
